crystal_phase.Cu0.65NbS2: JCPDS File No. 00-015-0409, space group: p63/mmc

Proof in the paper: The XRD peaks of bimetallic samples can be indexed with the hexagonal Cu0.65NbS2 structure (JCPDS File No. 00-015-0409, space group: p63/mmc). The EDS elemental mappings of bimetallic NbCu samples exhibit a homogeneous association between niobium, copper, and sulfur, suggesting the formation of bimetallic structures. HRTEM image of sulfided Nb and bimetallic NbCu0.3 catalysts show fringe spacings of 2.9, 3.2, and 6.6 Å that can be attributed to the (100), (004), and (002) planes of the Cu0.65NbS2 structure.
